thread_text:
Priya S: Quick sync: propose a micro-launch for private (VPC/onprem) focused on egress wiring presets + a safe operator upgrade lane. Keep UX minimal; installer flags + preflight validation only.

Liam O: +1. Suggest we limit presets to three: nat-relay, bgp-peer, preserve-egress. That balances field needs vs complexity.

Renee M: Add a managed-nat preset for locked-down customers. Note: preserve-egress will require explicit public IP provisioning and routing docs from the customer.

Priya S: Launch gates I want: quickstart docs, two pilots validated, a staging canary upgrade with rollback test, and basic telemetry for egress & upgrade outcomes.

Liam O: For upgrade flow let's do: canary fraction -> smoke checks -> drain -> ramp. CLI example: `redwood-operator upgrade --canary 10% --drain 120s --rollback-on-fail`. Smoke checks: egress IP match, http e2e, control-plane auth.

Renee M: Validation must include: IP routability, no overlapping prefixes, and BGP origin acceptance (match origin ASN). We'll add clear error codes for failures.

Priya S: Pilot prioritization: NuevaBank (needs IP preservation + audit logs) and OrbitAI (needs private KMS/HSM). That pushes KMS docs earlier.

Liam O: Installer flags draft: `--egress-mode=nat-relay|bgp-peer|preserve-egress`, `--preserve-egress-ip=198.51.100.7/32`, `--bgp-asn=65020`, `--canary=0.1`, `--egress-validate-only`. Default is nat-relay.

Renee M: Add a dry-run validator that performs BGP accept check and IP ownership test without flipping live config. Must surface recommended next steps if validation fails.

Priya S: Docs owner? Renee for netops doc and onboarding checklist. Liam owns installer + harness. I'll own launch criteria and customer comms.

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-14422: "egress preflight validator + upgrade harness" assigned to @Liam O and @Renee M, due in 9d.

Liam O: I'll add telemetry events `egress.preflight.status` and `upgrade.canary.result`. Also include a simple `--force-rollback` operator flag. ETA 2 sprints for pilot-ready.

Renee M: I'll draft onboarding template capturing ASN, allowed prefixes, peering window, and emergency contact. Also a short troubleshooting FAQ for NAT/timeouts.

deploy-bot: Staging dry-run scheduled: 2024-05-03T03:00:00Z.

Priya S: Good. Keep phase 1 intentionally small (no console mapping). If pilots succeed we'll expand presets and add console UI in phase 2. Reconvene after staging run.
